name: Cusco
blurb: Cusco is an established high-elevation destination in the Peruvian Andes known for its proximity to archaeological sites, the Sacred Valley, and historical Inca architecture. Online discussions note its popularity for museum visits, train rides along the Urubamba River, and walking-friendly streets.

positive: Enjoyable local food, coffee shops, and friendly locals
Fabulous train rides and walking-friendly areas
In-awe reactions to historical Incan fortresses and temples
negative: Temporary wired communication outages due to aging infrastructure
Exhausting multi-step transit required to reach Machu Picchu

They say macchu pichu is a once in a lifetime experience and it’s true bc to get there from Cusco you have to take a 1.5 hour drive to train station, a 1.5 hour train ride to the town outside of macchu pichu and then a half hour bus trip to the ruins. Ain’t no way I’m doing this again
The train ride along the Urumbamba (sp?) River? Fabulous. We stayed in Cuzco a couple of days and drank coca tea.
I am in Peru- in awe of the great Incan fort and temple Sacsayhuamán, built in the 1400s, high up in the Andes above Cusco. I will never get over it
